WoW: Forever

Destruction Warlock

Direct damage and burst: two instants on short cooldowns, and from 40 a new Fire filler.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60, on client 1.60.1.70938 with hotfixes through November 12. The talent order is Icy Veins' published one; Wowhead's two builds are described from its own text. Levels assume no Legacy TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.. Wowhead's Destruction rotation and stat pages predate launch (November 3) and its stat page calls its own order a best estimate. No raid opens until December 9, so the level-60 section rests on guides and on WoWSims' model, not on logs.

What Destruction is for

Burst whose timing you control. ShadowburnShadowburnLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost105 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard. at 20 is an instant on a 15-second cooldown that costs a Soul Shard and hands it back if the target dies within 8 seconds. ConflagrateConflagrateLevel 25 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownIgnites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect. at 25 is an instant on a 10-second cooldown that turns your ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 secBurns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec. into one hit.

From 40 it has its own filler. IncinerateIncinerateLevel 40 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost205 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate. is a Fire spell with a 2.5-second cast that deals 25% more to a target carrying your ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 secBurns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec.. Shadow and FlameShadow and FlameTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantHitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard. at 35 to 39 stops ConflagrateConflagrateLevel 25 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownIgnites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect. consuming ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8Cast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 secBurns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec. and makes ShadowburnShadowburnLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost105 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard. refund its shard, so both are cast on cooldown.

Solo, its talents add burst and not sustain. Wowhead's levelling page says that plainly and offers two builds: one for questing that borrows Affliction's sustain, and one deep in Destruction for players who level in dungeons, where a tank holds the enemies and mana matters less.

Icy Veins' ratings out of 5, from its three spec pages (November 9). A levelling score measures solo kill speed and nothing else.

The tree's answer to spell pushback is IntensityIntensityTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantGives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.: 3 points for a 70% chance that damage does not delay any Destruction cast.

Stat priority

Wowhead (November 3, from sim stat weights, and by its own word a best estimate for 60): Spell Power or Fire damage, then critical strike, Hit to the cap, Haste, Spell Pierce, Intellect, Spirit. It calls crit and Hit nearly tied.

Icy Veins (November 4): Hit to the cap, then Spell Power, Haste, critical strike, Intellect.

  • They disagree on Haste against critical strike. Wowhead puts 1% Haste at roughly 7 Spell Power and 1% crit or Hit at roughly 9.
  • Hit cap: 17% against raid bosses and 4% against an enemy of your own level. SuppressionSuppressionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%. 5/5 covers 5%.
  • RuinRuinTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%. 5/5 makes Destruction crits deal double damage. In Classic that took one point. Here it takes five, 20% a point.
  • Fire damage is worth about two-thirds of Spell Power to the IncinerateIncinerateLevel 40 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost205 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate. build and Shadow damage about a third, on Wowhead's figures.

Your demon

Summon ImpSummon ImpLevel 1 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost80% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons an Imp under the command of the Warlock. in your starting zone, VoidwalkerVoidwalkerLevel 10 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock. at 10, Summon SuccubusSummon SuccubusLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock. or Summon IncubusSummon IncubusLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock. at 20, Summon FelhunterSummon FelhunterLevel 30 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock. at 30, all from class quests. Destruction has no pet talents of its own.

  • Solo: Voidwalker until 20, then the Succubus or Incubus. Wowhead: keep the Voidwalker if you want the sturdier tank; it deals less damage.
  • Dungeons: the Imp, for Blood PactBlood PactTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases party members' Stamina by 4., with Fire ShieldFire ShieldTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost60 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration180 secSurrounds the target in a shield of fire. Every strike against the target causes 5 Fire damage to the attacker. Lasts 180 sec. Your pet cannot cast Fire Shield on itself. on the tank.
  • You are a stand-still caster without SuppressionSuppressionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.'s threat reduction in the early levels of every published order, so give the demon a moment before the first direct hit.

Demon Health was cut on November 2 and raised on November 6 and 10; the class page has the figures.
